summary: @ornikar/eslint-plugin-ornikar 24.0.2 executes obfuscated payload via downloaded Bun runtime at install time
details: The package's `preinstall` script runs `node setup.mjs`, which is itself obfuscated (obfuscator.io-style hex-named identifiers and inline lookup tables). setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts it into a temp directory, marks it executable, and then invokes it to run the sibling file `math_init.js` — a 727KB obfuscator.io-style bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header, string-array rotator, large encoded dictionary) with sha256 9fc2570b7cef51c1b8df116d144d11ff4096357be7d2c4c6367cfc2509cf1bcc. `math_init.js` is not referenced by `main`, `exports`, or any documented feature of the package (an ESLint plugin), and prior 23.x releases of this package do not contain setup.mjs or math_init.js. The alternate runtime is used specifically to execute an obfuscated bundled payload whose actions are hidden from Node-oriented static review, giving whoever published this version full-host code execution on any developer or CI machine that runs `npm install` on it.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
